fetched.title: Payment options - Neo4j Aura
fetched.text:
# Payment options

Aura usage is metered and aggregated based on billing dimensions, the result is priced according to Aura pricing plans.
For information on pricing, refer to Aura Pricing.

## Pay as you go

Pay-as-you-go (PAYG) allows you to consume Neo4j Aura products on an on-demand hourly basis.
It has no expiration date and continues as long as you use the products.

Usage is metered hourly and you are billed monthly for the previous month.
At every billing cycle, usage from the previous month is priced, invoiced, and then charged to your payment method.

To set up PAYG billing with Neo4j Aura, use one of the following methods:

* Enter a credit card on the payment methods page in the Neo4j Aura console.
  After entering a credit card, you also have the option to pre-purchase credits on the same page.
* Subscribe to Neo4j Aura through a cloud marketplace.
  At the marketplace’s billing cycle, Aura usage is aggregated and charged as part of your cloud bill.
  The following cloud marketplaces are supported:

  + AWS
  + Microsoft Azure
  + Google Cloud

## Prepaid

You can commit to using Aura for a minimum of one year and purchase Aura Consumption Units (ACUs).

This requires the Neo4j Sales team.
The prepaid option does not renew automatically.

There are two separate channels for purchasing ACUs:

* Direct invoicing with Neo4j
* Purchasing ACUs through marketplace private offers (GCP, AWS or Azure).

There is no billing integration with marketplaces for prepaid contracts.
The contract is executed as a private offer, Neo4j instructs the marketplace to invoice the user for a number of ACUs and nothing else.
Neo4j does not provision an Aura environment automatically in this case, does not report usage to the marketplace for these deals, and the marketplace does not keep track of the remaining balance.

## Aura Consumption Unit (ACU)

Each billing dimension has its own unit of measure, GB-hours, GB-minutes, MB-hours, GB etc.
To aggregate and then pay for usage across different dimensions, Aura Consumption Units (ACUs) are used.
All Aura resources are priced in ACUs.
Users purchase ACUs as part of their prepaid contract, and then use them to cover for the usage that is also expressed in ACU.

Keep in mind that ACUs have a start date and an expiration date.
They need to be used before their expiration date, or they are forfeited.

## Applying Aura credits to your account

Aura customers can receive a credit allowance expressed as a number of Aura Consumption Units (ACU).

The credits can be purchased through a prepaid Aura contract, or granted by Neo4j as part of a promotional marketing program, proof of concept, developer program, and more.

These credits are then used to offset your Aura usage bill.
When all credits are depleted, the remaining usage that was not covered by credits will be invoiced and charged to your payment method.

Credits have a start date and an expiration date.
Usage that occurs before the start date will not be covered by credits.
If not used by the expiration date, credits are forfeited.

To redeem the credits:

* You will receive an email from Neo4j containing an activation code.
* Log into the Aura console, and choose the organization where you want to redeem the credits. **Note:** You need to be an organization owner or admin to redeem the credits.
* Navigate to **Billing**
* Click **Redeem credits**
* Type in the activation code, and click **Apply**. You should see the amount of ACUs that will be granted. [See Figure 2]

Figure 1. ACU credit entitlement

* If necessary, select a billing account that you want to apply the credits to.
* Confirm the operation.

You will see the credit balance on the billing account tile that you applied the credits to.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
|  | You cannot redeem credits before their start date. |

Credit allowances sometimes require you to have a valid credit card on file.
If this is the case, you will be asked to add one as part of the redeem flow.

## Contract lifecycle

1. The user signs a contract with Neo4j for a given period (one or more contract terms) and buys a number of ACUs to be used in each yearly contract term.
2. The user consumes Aura resources priced in ACUs.
3. The usage (priced in ACU) is deducted from the ACU balance throughout the month.
4. If the user runs out of ACUs before their expiration date, they are invoiced for the overage.
5. At expiration date, all ACUs remaining are forfeited.
   If the current term is part of a multi-year contract, some of the remaining balance can be rolled over to the next term, if one exists.
   This has to be documented in the initial contract.

fetched.title: Free trial - Neo4j Aura
fetched.text:
# Free trial

The Aura free trial applies to either **AuraDB Professional** or **AuraDB Business Critical** and gives you access to Graph Analytics in Aura, Aura Agent, Virtual Graph, and other products and features.
The free trial grants you $150 in credits, valid for 14 days.
Use the trial to explore the platform, prototype your application, and plan your workload for production.

## Get started with the free trial

1. Create a Neo4j Aura account
2. Complete the sign-up process, you will be prompted to start a 14-day free trial.
   Alternatively, you can start a free trial from the Instances page.

Your free trial begins once the instance is created.

Figure 1. Create an instance with the free trial

## What is included in the free trial

Your free trial includes:

* 14 days and $150 in Aura credits, valid from the start of your trial.
* **AuraDB Professional**: a production-grade, fully-managed graph database.
* **AuraDB Business Critical**: high availability with multi-AZ architecture and 99.95% uptime SLA.
* **Aura Graph Analytics**: run 65+ graph algorithms directly on your data.
* Full access to all other Aura platform features, within the Trial limits.

Your trial ends either after 14 days or when your $150 credits are fully consumed.
You can check your remaining balance at any time in the Aura Billing page.

## Trial limits

To prevent accidental overuse, the following limits are in place during the free trial:

* AuraDB Professional/Business Critical:

  + Maximum number of **running** instances: 1
  + Maximum instance size: 4GB memory
* Aura Graph Analytics

  + Maximum size: 8GB memory
  + Maximum concurrent sessions: 3
* Aura Agent

  + Maximum number of external agents: 1
* Virtual Graphs

  + Maximum instance size: 4GB memory
  + Maximum number of running instances: 1

## Extend your trial

If you need more time to evaluate Aura, you can extend your trial directly from the Aura console.

To extend your trial:

1. Log in to the Aura console
2. Select **Extend trial** from the header and enter your credit card details.

Your trial is extended by **seven additional days** and you receive an additional **$75 in Aura credits**.
Your credit card will **not** be charged for any usage until your extended trial period ends or your remaining credits are consumed, whichever comes first.
After that, your account automatically converts to Pay-as-you-go option billing.

## Continue using Aura after your trial

When you free trial ends, you can continue using Neo4j Aura in the following ways:

### Pay-as-you-go option

The easiest way to continue to use Aura is to pay-as-you-go (PAYG).
You are charged for active consumption based on the products you have deployed.
Pricing details can be found at the Neo4j Pricing page.

There are two ways to set up PAYG:

* **Enter a credit card** in the Aura console.
* **Subscribe to Neo4j via cloud marketplaces**.
  All marketplace listings are PAYG and allow you to consolidate Neo4j billing with your existing cloud spend, including any committed spend programs (such as AWS EDPs, Azure MACCs, or GCP CUDs):

### Prepaid option

If you prefer predictable costs or have enterprise procurement requirements, contact the Neo4j Sales team to discuss a prepaid commitment plan.

### Continue with AuraDB Free

If you are not ready to move to a paid plan, you can continue using AuraDB Free instead.
AuraDB Free is a good starting point if you want to learn Cypher, follow tutorials, or explore graph concepts.
The Free tier is available indefinitely, but has limitations compared to the paid plans.
See the Neo4j Pricing page for details.

## Get help

If you have questions during your trial, the following resources are available:

* Support - submit a support ticket for technical issues
* Documentation - The full Neo4j Aura documentation
* GraphAcademy - Free online courses and certifications - start with Neo4j Fundamentals
* Community forums - Ask questions and get answers from the Neo4j community
* Developer Discord - Chat with Neo4j developers and community members in real time
